# Collateral Management Policy

We take collateral for loans and trades. People should check the things and make sure they look good.
Sometimes we ask legal if it's okay. Most of the time it's fine.

We mostly do bonds and stocks but sometimes other things. If something is risky then maybe apply a
discount. The desk decides what works. There is no need to write everything down because people
know what to do.

Exceptions happen but usually we just do it.
Reporting is ad hoc and only done when someone asks.
There is no formal monitoring, and roles are not really defined.

This Collateral Management Policy follows the structure and format defined in the organization's Policy Document Template. The policy is divided into sections that cover the purpose, scope, definitions, policy statements, roles and responsibilities, procedures and controls, compliance and enforcement, and review and update processes.
